All 4 tests pass. Here's a summary of what was done:

---

**Root cause:** `inclusive-range.mjs` used a strict less-than (`< end`) in the loop condition, so the `end` value was never pushed into the array. This broke three of the four tests (ascending range, singleton, and negative range).

**Fix applied** — one character change in `inclusive-range.mjs`:
```diff
-  for (let value = start; value < end; value += 1) values.push(value);
+  for (let value = start; value <= end; value += 1) values.push(value);
```

Changing `<` to `<=` makes the loop include `end` in ascending/equal ranges, while still returning `[]` for descending ranges (since `start > end` means the loop body never executes).
